title: Replace landing page logo with gothic text wordmark

requirements.text: Update the main landing page hero branding to remove the logo image and instead display the text "Falcon Id's" styled as a gothic wordmark (using existing loaded fonts and Tailwind classes), keeping the hero section centered and responsive.

quotes: Remove the logo on main page just type out Falcon Id's in gothic letters

acceptanceCriteria: On the landing page (route "/"), the hero area no longer renders the logo/wordmark.
The hero displays the exact text: "Falcon Id's" (including apostrophe) as the primary brand mark.
The new text wordmark remains centered, visually prominent, and responsive across mobile and desktop breakpoints.
No broken image requests are made for "/assets/generated/falcon-ids-wordmark-gothic-transparent.dim_1200x300.png" from the landing page hero after the change.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only components).
nonGoals: Do not implement the previously requested support ticketing system in this change.
Do not change the site favicon or apple-touch icon assets.
Do not alter backend canister logic or data models.
